limits: Bounded manual content/clarity review; no real user, browser, keyboard or screen-reader acceptance.
Questions frozen before lookup, separate from authored regression cases; inherited author context is disclosed in survey.
No current work/container state or operational database connection; current-state questions can only receive bounded triage.

method.sample: 24 frozen scenario questions derived from owner seeds and primary public workflow documentation; not usage statistics or real-user acceptance.
method.independence: Questions frozen before searching this app; separate from authored regression cases. Evaluator has inherited project and SDD-author context; not a fresh-context audit.
method.retrieval: One exact original question per actual loopback GET /api/search; score only the returned top eight, without query rewriting, out-of-top-eight recovery or new topic authoring.
method.inspection: Read all 98 returned topic core explanations and documentary refinements, selected detailed contracts, and 12 cited source-detail HTTP responses. Stored all response snapshots. The source-detail samples expose reviewed claim provenance or captured SQL, not a new complete recertification of original vendor sources.
method.adequate: The complete returned topic content, including expandable detail, covers the question at its answerability boundary. Current-state cases require useful bounded checks and explicit inability to know unseen current state. Adequate does not imply a direct initial search snippet, a complete configuration SOP or implemented workflow verification.
method.partial: Returned material covers a material part, but an identified requested subquestion or usable triage/configuration path remains absent.
method.missing: No substantive answer to the requested intent within the top eight; lexical matches and general descriptions do not count.
method.correctness: Inspect response scope, internal consistency and cited reviewed/source sample support. No unsupported diagnosis observed is not a proof that every underlying source statement is correct in every environment.
method.clarity: Manual plain-language reading of returned text and renderer structure; no browser, keyboard, screen-reader or vision-user acceptance. A substantive adequate answer can still have partial clarity.

cross_cutting_findings.finding: How-to configuration and symptom questions often retrieve generic process or specialist SQL topics. Relevant information is fragmented or absent.
Work closure lacks a concise instruction/confirmation triage and a safe support-report template.

The baseline still asks for product/version or installed version in generic input/evidence text and putaway-groups-version-limit. Owner has attested the replica is current and requests no build/version gate. Retain conflicting source provenance while removing unnecessary user-facing version requests in a later authorized integration.
An unspecified setting request produces unrelated matches instead of asking for the setting label.

results.question: What is the difference between Work Insight and Warehouse Mobile, and where should I start when a task is stuck?

judgment.answer_basis: Documentary refinements r04-r05 distinguish non-RF confirmation in Work Insight from RF sign-on and execution.
judgment.exact_missing_subquestion: No direct Work Insight versus Warehouse Mobile comparison, or first triage branch for a stuck task.
judgment.clarity_reason: Relevant distinction is buried in expanded process refinements; the initial answer defines work instead of comparing the interfaces.

results.question: I can see the work in Work Insight, but it does not appear on my handheld. What should I check?

judgment.answer_basis: Refinements r05 and r08 identify active/default or authorized profile, eligible work type, zone/equipment, assignment and selection ordering; scope explicitly excludes the current user and work state.
judgment.exact_missing_subquestion: None for bounded initial triage. The actual reason this operator cannot see this work remains unknown.
judgment.clarity_reason: Useful plain operational checks appear only after opening a generic Work topic; RF and profile terminology could be explained at the point of use.

results.question: Why does a work unit still show open after I picked everything?

judgment.answer_basis: A work unit contains instructions; non-RF confirmation is a separate step (work r04), and monitor counts separate units from instructions.
judgment.exact_missing_subquestion: Which remaining instruction, confirmation or movement step should be checked when picking appears finished; the answer does not distinguish that work-unit case directly.
judgment.clarity_reason: Core definitions are readable, but monitoring counts and generic process text require the reader to assemble a closure explanation.

results.question: I cannot close this work unit. Which incomplete step or status should I look at first?

judgment.answer_basis: Work separates execution from confirmation; status explains header leading/trailing and line/container flows without claiming the current state.
judgment.exact_missing_subquestion: A work-unit-specific ordered closure check and distinction from receipt/shipment status. The first result discusses a different status entity.
judgment.clarity_reason: Generic status terminology can distract from the failed work-unit action; no direct first-check instruction.

results.question: Can I cancel this stuck work, or will that leave inventory in the wrong place?

judgment.answer_basis: The cancellation helper can remove instructions and change source allocated/destination in-transit quantities; its return code and transaction handling have explicit limits.
judgment.exact_missing_subquestion: How to identify the applicable cancellation path, physical movement already completed and safe authorized next action for this particular work; a narrow replenishment helper cannot answer all work cancellation.
judgment.clarity_reason: SQL return-code and predicate language is specialist material rather than an operator-facing cancellation triage.

results.question: Where do I find the reason a pick failed, instead of just trying the same action again?

judgment.answer_basis: The first result maps actions to status numbers; Work describes general execution. Neither supplies a failed-pick history or error lookup path.
judgment.exact_missing_subquestion: Where to inspect the failed-pick reason and which error/history evidence to capture before retrying.
judgment.clarity_reason: Action mapping and unrelated QC display semantics obscure the simple troubleshooting intent.

results.question: How do I configure which work a user can receive on Warehouse Mobile?

judgment.answer_basis: Work r05/r08 and selection explain work profile, authorized alternatives, type/zone/equipment and assignment order; no current profile is inferred.
judgment.exact_missing_subquestion: A configuration sequence tying a user to a profile and its ordered details, with each setting explained and the resulting eligibility distinguished from current work.
judgment.clarity_reason: The applicable selection topic is rank 7 and includes procedure branches and caps; no short configuration walkthrough.

results.question: The location has fewer units than my work says to pick. What should I check before reporting a short pick?

judgment.answer_basis: Work r06 covers location/quantity verification and short-pick inventory effects; replenishment r05 distinguishes waiting/partial pick and in-transit coverage.
judgment.exact_missing_subquestion: A concise pre-short-pick checklist to reconcile the selected work, physical location/LP and quantity/UOM before recording a shortage; the actual shortage cannot be diagnosed.
judgment.clarity_reason: Useful checks are scattered across generic topics and expanded refinements.

results.question: What settings decide which putaway location SCALE recommends?

judgment.answer_basis: Location type/capacity/restrictions, locating rule sequences and strategy, assignment, and delayed-locating/Create Putaway Work dependency explain which settings determine recommendations.
judgment.exact_missing_subquestion: None for a general explanation of the deciding settings; an installed effective rule and exact navigation remain outside this answer.
judgment.clarity_reason: Plain process explanation is useful; the relevant locating topic is rank 4 and a technical lookup topic follows it.

results.question: Why is this pallet going to an exception location when another location looks empty?

judgment.answer_basis: Capacity/product restrictions and ordered eligible-location strategy explain why visually empty is insufficient; locating r01 points to Process History for decisions and r02 notes another item permanent assignment exclusion.
judgment.exact_missing_subquestion: None for bounded initial triage. The actual rule evaluation and reason for this pallet require current authorized context; no universal exception-location cause is asserted.
judgment.clarity_reason: Reader must open rank 6 to find decision history; no single plain-language exception-location checklist.

results.question: How do I set a different receiving process for damaged goods and returns?

judgment.answer_basis: Returns distinguishes good/bad receipt, reason/disposition and grouping; r03 explains optional reason/disposition effects on condition and locating.
judgment.exact_missing_subquestion: How to configure and assign the differing receiving/returns preferences, condition/disposition and locating path as a coherent setup.
judgment.clarity_reason: Behavior is understandable, but a how-to-configure question receives a process description and generalized evidence requests.

results.question: Why is receiving asking for a lot or serial number for this item?

judgment.answer_basis: Item text identifies lot/serial controls and receiving configuration; serial linkage distinguishes item mode and serial group counts.
judgment.exact_missing_subquestion: Which item tracking/template/preference option triggers this receiving prompt and how to check it safely without inventing the current item setting.
judgment.clarity_reason: Item overview is readable; the serial procedure topic concerns movement linkage rather than the reason for the prompt.

results.question: How do I stop users receiving more than the expected quantity?

judgment.answer_basis: Receiving asks which over/under controls are active but does not explain a control that prevents overreceiving.
judgment.exact_missing_subquestion: Which overreceipt setting or tolerance to change, its scope, and what a zero/disabled choice actually enforces.
judgment.clarity_reason: A readable receiving summary does not answer the requested configuration action.

results.question: How do I configure the packing station so workers get the right container choices?

judgment.answer_basis: Packing presentation resolves the user packing preference and documents missing-row/null behavior; wave container creation describes packing class and container group.
judgment.exact_missing_subquestion: How the station/user packing preference, container assignment and eligible container choices fit together, including a bounded setup sequence.
judgment.clarity_reason: The pertinent topic starts with NULL scalar-subquery semantics rather than what a packing preference does.

results.question: I scanned the shipment at Packing, but no items appeared. What should I check?

judgment.answer_basis: Packing starts from allocated/picked quantities; packing refinements describe container association and wave/container validation.
judgment.exact_missing_subquestion: An ordered no-items-after-scan triage: correct initiation identifier/context, eligible quantities/status, assignment and whether the relevant preference displays the intended contents. Actual shipment state remains unknown.
judgment.clarity_reason: The generic process answer does not guide the worker from this observed screen symptom to the next check.

results.question: What does Close Container actually do, and what happens to the container afterward?

judgment.answer_basis: Packing r01 explains weight/container data collection and no further packing; r03/r04 describe validations, manifesting, status advancement, configured paperwork, optional load/next move and history. Print selection is distinguished from successful output.
judgment.exact_missing_subquestion: None for the general meaning and subsequent documented stages. Active choices and the actual next action for one container are not established.
judgment.clarity_reason: The answer is available in expanded refinements on rank 2; rank 1 answers print selection rather than closure.

results.question: I packed all the items, but the container will not close. How do I find what is missing?

judgment.answer_basis: Packing r03 gives concrete checks for released wave, correct shipment/container membership, pending QC and pending VAS; the response explicitly excludes current transaction state.
judgment.exact_missing_subquestion: None for bounded initial triage. It is not an exhaustive installed validation list and does not identify this container actual blocker.
judgment.clarity_reason: Helpful checks are in a dense expanded refinement; QC/VAS abbreviations and international restrictions need a short-first explanation.

results.question: Why does Packing reject a replacement LPN even though the item looks the same?

judgment.answer_basis: Item and packing descriptions cover general attributes/validation but no replacement-LPN equivalence or allowed substitution rule appears in the returned top eight.
judgment.exact_missing_subquestion: Which attributes besides item identity make a replacement LPN eligible, and which comparison/error to inspect for this rejection.
judgment.clarity_reason: Readable general summaries provide no usable response to the specific replacement-LPN symptom.

results.question: Can I move an item from one container to another after packing has started?

judgment.answer_basis: Transfer helpers have explicit narrow mutation scopes and caller-consistency limits; packing r01 says closing prevents further packing.
judgment.exact_missing_subquestion: Whether this in-progress source/destination pair can be repacked or transferred through an authorized application action, with open/closed state and quantity constraints.
judgment.clarity_reason: The useful transfer topic is rank 7 and speaks in row mutations rather than explaining a supported packing action.

results.question: How do I configure whether packing happens on a workstation or on a mobile device?

judgment.answer_basis: Packing preference and general flow are returned, while rank 1 is automation Device Integration Framework; no desktop/mobile packing selection setup is explained.
judgment.exact_missing_subquestion: How workstation and Warehouse Mobile packing modes are selected and what preference/user/device bindings configure each.
judgment.clarity_reason: Automation integration is an irrelevant leading result; packing preference fallback is too narrow to answer interface setup.

results.question: What information should I give you when I report that a work unit or container cannot close?

judgment.answer_basis: Work defines unit/instruction context, monitor topics identify warehouse/work-group/filter scope, and all exclude current operational records.
judgment.exact_missing_subquestion: A short safe report template containing interface/action, sanitized error wording, relevant unit/container and instruction states, last completed step and expected result; distinguish work closure from container closure.
judgment.clarity_reason: The response requires assembling a report from generic process and counting descriptions.

results.question: Can you explain this setting in plain language and show where the explanation comes from?

judgment.answer_basis: The query does not name a setting. Search returns tolerance, permission and language topics without first obtaining that missing identifier.
judgment.exact_missing_subquestion: Ask which setting or exact visible label the user means, then give its effect, scope, limits and linked source; do not infer that the first tolerance result is the requested setting.
judgment.clarity_reason: Unrelated readable explanations cannot resolve an unspecified reference to this setting.

results.question: How do I configure when labels print during packing, and what should I check if closing a container prints nothing?

judgment.answer_basis: Label prerequisites, document process/default pairs, user printers and selection versus physical output are explained; the sampled packing SQL exposes AUTO_PRINT_AT_CLOSE but the plain topic does not explain how that setting controls the flow.
judgment.exact_missing_subquestion: A plain configuration path for packing close-trigger printing, plus a sequenced no-output check from trigger eligibility to selection, routing/dispatch and acknowledgment.
judgment.clarity_reason: Good initial separation of prerequisites and output; setting meaning is left inside SQL and technical contract details.

results.question: How do I configure which items may share a container and which must stay separate?

judgment.answer_basis: Wave refinements discuss pallet ordering and pick groups, but the top eight contain no explanation of item packing-class/container cohabitation or separation controls.
judgment.exact_missing_subquestion: Which packing class, strategy, criteria or container-group constraints govern mixing versus separation, and how those are assigned.
judgment.clarity_reason: The leading seed-registration result is unrelated to physical container contents; a relevant container strategy topic is absent from this top eight.

receipt_scope: Product-facing judgments and immutable source bindings. Full HTTP response snapshots retained locally; no private workspace payload published.
